items.alt: A benchmark dashboard links eleven professional domains to expert-created tasks, three model attempts, reviewable deliverables, grading notes and cost records.
A simulation pipeline routes camera paths, control signals and LiDAR conditions through Cosmos services into generated scenes, validation checks and robotics training.
A financial analyst compares revenue growth, operating results, compute commitments and capacity-financing risks on a primary-source AI company filing review board.
A knowledge team defines a document schema, ingests a bounded corpus and reviews permission-aware search results, citations, stale items and missing evidence.
A person reviews an everyday planning note containing constraints, source links, dates, costs, unresolved questions and a final human decision.
A review group completes a one-page AI decision record with the problem, evidence, owner, full cost, assumptions, stop criteria and next observation.
